title: File BL-8: the batch line format
body:
The convert-batch milestone plan cannot be written until the batch line format is fixed, so this files BL-8 instead: request-line grammar, error-line text, which stream each goes to, and the exit code for a batch with a failed line. HIGH risk, with a proposed default. docs/DESIGN.md section 11 leaves it undecided and OD-4 says this plan must file it rather than settle it.

Opened by the delivery driver on base run/web.
